title: SDK rewrite
description: Rewrite one SDK on the new runtime, phase by phase, with a team review before cutover.

proofKinds.title: Protocol tests pass
proofKinds.setup: The new client built from the models, and the protocol test suite.
proofKinds.action: Run every protocol test against the new client.
proofKinds.failureMeans: The new client does not speak the protocol yet.
proofKinds.nextDecision: Fix the failing area, or narrow the cutover.

proofKinds.title: Cutover dry run
proofKinds.setup: A copy of the callers switched to the new client.
proofKinds.action: Run the callers' own tests against the new client.
proofKinds.expected: The callers' tests pass with no change to their code.
proofKinds.failureMeans: The new client changes behavior callers rely on.
proofKinds.nextDecision: Fix the client, or list the change in the release notes.
